```{r setup}
library(bioRtools)
```

`lm_analysis()` fits a linear model and provides a reusable plot object.

```{r}
data(test_data)

lm_result <- lm_analysis(
  data = test_data,
  x = "Sepal.Length",
  y = "Sepal.Width",
  group = "Species",
  color = "Species"
)

names(lm_result)
lm_result$plot
```
